  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]

  WHY: A line like "SERENA_QUERY ... FOO_QUERY ..." counts SERENA correctly but discards FOO_QUERY without fallback parsing or logging, undercounting generic telemetry.

  WHY: If the test file is not executed by the workflow allowlists, parser bugs can pass CI undetected until a manual operator run.

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py:228-230 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Added comment correctly states the three-state JSON/markdown contract preservation intent, but does not flag that this fail-open silently inflates probe_skipped with unparseable result= values, masking potential emitter bugs from operator audits.
  WHY: Malformed SERENA_PROBE lines (e.g., missing result= or garbage) accumulate in probe_skipped without distinct observability; if an emitter starts emitting bad result= formats, probe_failed stays 0 while skipped spikes, delaying root-cause detection in cost audits.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:259-261 | severity=medium | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: Added comment accurately justifies the one-match-per-line break for known-server guards, but omits that it drops subsequent unknown-server prefixes on multi-prefix lines without fallback parsing or logging.
  WHY: Rare multi-prefix lines like "SERENA_QUERY ... FOO_QUERY ..." count SERENA correctly but silently discard FOO_QUERY; other_mcp misses future MCP signals appended to known-server lines, undercounting generic telemetry in audits.
- tests/test_cost_audit_serena_metrics.py:1-262 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: New test file verifies scoped parse_log cases but is absent from CI allowlists in .github/workflows/ci.yml (python3 tests/test_*.py lines ~150-160), mark-stable.yml (~200), test-and-mark-stable.yml (~300); regressions in Serena/MCP parsing evade CI.
  WHY: cost_audit.py parser bugs (e.g., new emitter formats) pass CI undetected until manual operator run; Semble parity incomplete as new tests never execute in release gate.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
